title: Canada's 100-Foot Freight Railway To Nowhere
summary: A short, sarcastic Half as Interesting video about a tiny freight railway in Canada built to exploit a shipping regulation loophole. It explains how a track just 100 feet long counted as a railway.
why: HN recommends the channel for short, wry videos on obscure topics, and this one is cited as an example of gaming rules via a loophole.

quote.text: HAI makes interesting, short, sarcastic videos about obscure topics that HNers will probably enjoy.
